keyFindings.description: Three descriptions of the hold model still state the model this round replaced, and one of them states the deleted branch as the rule. (1) packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md:436: 'One the listener does not take back is tried again while it is under the host session's own id, which this process heartbeats; under a session it has left it is abandoned to the listener's reaping' - that is exactly the host-dependent branch edit 2 deleted, and the same bullet describes adoption with no same-session requirement ('unless the session the host is then on wants that role, whose hold it is again'), where the code now requires sessionOpen(hold.id) at :2296-2300. This file is the package's engineering guidance and is read by every agent working here, so it tells the next maintainer to restore the branch whose removal is the point of the round. (2) envoy.ts:618 says abandonedHolds holds 'Holds this process gave up under a session it has left', which :2280 ('whatever session it is under') and :2318 (every entry of `failed`) contradict three screens below it: a hand-back that fails under the session this process still runs now lands there too. (3) envoy.ts:2281 says 'the next accepted registration makes it a pending hand-back again', where registerSession re-promotes before issuing the request - the loop at :1601-1604 precedes the client.subscribe call - so it happens at the attempt whether or not the answer arrives; AGENTS.md's own 'any registration of that session by this process, in a pass or not and answered or not' is the accurate statement, so the two documents also disagree. No behaviour is wrong and nothing is hidden: this is documentation. It is carried rather than deferred because the round's stated purpose was an invariant the next reader checks against, the text is newly written this round, and its concrete failure mode is the reintroduction of the branch whose absence closes rounds 5 and 6. Three text edits, no code. If the architect judges an eighth round disproportionate for that, it should say so and the reviewer will approve on its word.

roundSevenVerified: settleEndedHolds(wanted, live) at envoy.ts:2285 takes no host; one caller at :2358 passes two arguments. The captured host is not representable.
The failed loop abandons unconditionally at :2318, so nothing it writes can be adopted later.
Adoption is gated on sessionOpen(hold.id) at :2296-2300 and reads neither claimedRoleTopic nor holdUnconfirmed, so the loop no longer reads a variable it writes.

abandonedHolds is keyed ${topic}@${id} with every reader following: registerSession selects by hold.id and re-promotes under the same key (:1601-1604), observeAbandonedHold looks up and updates by that key (:1871-1893), and the claimed-branch cleanup sweeps every entry of the topic (:1950-1955). The collision it fixes - two failed hand-backs of one role under two sessions, one dropped - is a defect none of the six previous rounds named.

The writers of claimedRoleSessionID are still :1966, :2005, :2302 and supersedes still has its two sources (:2382, :2394), so the recorded residual at :1957-1966 is narrowed, not widened, and round 7 adds no path.
